package.name: demo_square_mission
package.description:
A complete autonomous sortie in one C++ state machine, flown entirely over the /wrapper/psdk_ros2 surface: check battery and vehicle status, take control authority, take off, fly two laps of a small circle on the RC stick channel, then return home and land.
Publishes a human-readable status line on ~/state and answers ~/start and ~/abort (std_srvs/Trigger).
